headline: Tasnim says 'related to activities in the Strait of Hormuz', no damage
dek: [VERIFIED FACT] Two explosions heard on Qeshm Island (Suza area) and several explosions at Jask port, plus reports from Bandar Abbas and Sirik, Saturday evening Nov 7 (IRNA via Reuters/Haaretz/JPost). No damage reported on Qeshm so far (Tasnim/state TV via AJ liveblog 21:15 GMT).
sources: IRNA / Iranian state TV via Reuters, Haaretz, JPost; Tasnim (semi-official) via AJ liveblog 21:15 GMT; ISNA via JPost
fault_line: American strike or Iranian activity? Tehran's own agencies now hint the blasts came from their side of the strait -- was this a US hit, or Iran firing and calling it an attack?
